requirements.WEB-WORKOUT-REOPEN: Completed and planned work, edited reps and session identity survive reopening
requirements.WEB-OFFLINE-RESUME: Cached app resumes and banks an existing workout without a network
requirements.WEB-UPDATE-RESUME: A real worker update preserves active work and other projects' caches
requirements.WEB-BACKUP-ROUNDTRIP: A synthetic blank-workout export restores its portable content in a fresh browser context
requirements.WEB-RESTORE-CONTENT: Same-count changed values prompt for restore; cancel preserves current work
requirements.WEB-PLATE-LABELS: F1–F8 preserve readable denominations and lb→kg totals at phone and desktop widths
requirements.WEB-EXERCISE-FAVORITES: Favorites persist, compose with search and filters, preserve keyboard focus, and select from the shared session picker
requirements.WEB-EQUIPMENT-CONTEXT: Category artwork reserves layout during delayed decode, fits edge widths and zoom, and remains available offline
